settings.label: Application (client) ID
settings.help: Of a Microsoft Entra app registration. Empty = SIMULATED demonstration mode.

settings.label: Directory (tenant) ID
settings.help: The tenant GUID. Token issuers are tenant-specific: a specific GUID is required, 'common'/'organizations' cannot be validated.

authMethod.name: Microsoft
authMethod.description: Federated sign-in with a Microsoft Entra account (OpenID Connect: issuer, audience, signature and nonce checks; the tenant GUID pins the issuer). The account must be explicitly linked to a local account.

setupGuide.intro: Everything happens on this screen. Leave the Client ID empty to try the simulated demo mode (screen marked DEMO, fictional accounts).
steps: Open the {console} > Identity > Applications > App registrations > New registration. See the {docs}.
Add a redirect URI of platform Web and paste exactly:
Under Certificates & secrets, create a client secret. Copy the Application (client) ID and the secret VALUE into the fields below, then Save.
Set the Tenant field to match the registration: common (any account), organizations, consumers, or your directory tenant ID.
Each person then links their Microsoft account from their Profile page (Linked sign-in providers). No automatic linking by e-mail.
